turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
We. Who else has seen this?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31 PM. I'm writing that down. Was Owen asked about any of this before the zero went in?
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
He wrote it over the weekend, and people paste in their own drafts. Show me the history itself, not your account of it.
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Don't. The history. Is it on that screen or isn't it?
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.
A seventeen-year-old getting a quotation wrong is a bad citation, not an offence. Which three editions, and put the page of his essay in front of me.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
That's twice, Hale. I asked for a page, not a compliment.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.
He changed his mind between an outline and a draft. That's called writing. You keep describing documents, and nothing has been put in front of me.
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.

A machine's opinion. Turnitin's own guide says its indicator "should not be used as the sole basis for adverse actions against a student," and I have it printed in my bag. Your own procedure says the same.
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
Nothing in this room is off the record. I'm not in your chair, I'm across from it. The zero comes off.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.
Ten minutes. That's 4.4, and the part about his record goes in writing whatever else happens. But a rewrite for what, when not one document has been put in front of me?
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? Owen. The documents.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.
A threat isn't evidence. That zero was entered before anyone called me, which breaks 4.2, so go to the vice principal Monday if you like. I'll be in the principal's office today.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Neither, until I've seen what you say you have. Put the history on that screen, Hale, or withdraw the mark.
